content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration were conducted during the period of development of these guidelines up to and including 2020.
